newsitem.title: USA: Octagon, Conversion Tech merger on hold.
newsitem.headline: Octagon, Conversion Tech merger on hold.

text.p: Octagon Inc and Conversion Technologies International Inc said Wednesday they were considering terminating their proposed merger.
In a joint statement, the companies said a special meeting of Octagon shareholders to approve the deal scheduled for June 16 did not convene and no new meeting date had been scheduled.
The companies said they were "in discussions regarding certain possible future business relationships, including a possible agreement to terminate the merger."
Their current merger pact expires June 30, the companies said.
Conversion Technologies produces substrates for use as industrial abrasives while Octagon provides radiological control and operations to nuclear utilities.
